```bash
$targets = @(
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_025133_209787100.jsonl"; lines=@(1,10,22) },
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_023125_842142100.jsonl"; lines=@(1) },
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_023736_351495600.jsonl"; lines=@(1) },
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_025345_862188800.jsonl"; lines=@(1,10,22) }
)
foreach ($t in $targets) {
  Write-Host "==== $($t.f) ===="
  $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines((Resolve-Path $t.f))
  foreach ($n in $t.lines) {
    $line = $raw[$n-1]
    # extract fields via regex to avoid PS JSON escaping quirks
    $owner = if ($line -match '"owner":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }
    $created = if ($line -match '"created_by":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }

    # show whether absolute path / email present
    $hasEmail = $line -match '@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}'
    $hasAbsPath = $line -match 'Users\\\\graff|Users/graff|\\\\?\\C:'

}
```

```bash
function Redact-OwnerEmail([string]$path, [int[]]$lineNums) {
  $full = (Resolve-Path $path).Path
  $lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
  $lines.AddRange([string[]][System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($full))
  $changed = @()
  foreach ($n in $lineNums) {
    $i = $n - 1
    $before = $lines[$i]
    $after = $before -replace '"owner":"pendragon\.josh@gmail\.com"', '"owner":"[REDACTED]"'
    # also drop absolute source_repo_path if any remain (defensive)
    $after = $after -replace '"source_repo_path":"\\\\[^"]*"', '"source_repo_path":"."'
    if ($after -ne $before) {
      $lines[$i] = $after
      $changed += "L$n"
    } else {
      # diagnose why no change
      $owner = if ($before -match '"owner":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }
      $srp = if ($before -match '"source_repo_path":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }
      Write-Host "NOCHANGE $path L$n owner=[$owner] srp=[$srp]"
    }
  }
  if ($changed.Count -gt 0) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($full, $lines)
    Write-Host "UPDATED $path $($changed -join ',')"
  }
}

Redact-OwnerEmail ".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_023125_842142100.jsonl" @(1)

Redact-OwnerEmail ".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_025345_862188800.jsonl" @(1)

# Validate cited lines
Write-Host "`n=== VALIDATION ==="
$checks = @(
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_025133_209787100.jsonl"; lines=@(1,10,22) },
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_023125_842142100.jsonl"; lines=@(1) },
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_023736_351495600.jsonl"; lines=@(1) },
  @{ f=".beads/.br_history/issues.20260727_025345_862188800.jsonl"; lines=@(1,10,22) }
)
$fail = 0
foreach ($c in $checks) {
  $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines((Resolve-Path $c.f))
  foreach ($n in $c.lines) {
    $line = $raw[$n-1]
    $owner = if ($line -match '"owner":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }
    $created = if ($line -match '"created_by":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }
    $srp = if ($line -match '"source_repo_path":"([^"]*)"') { $Matches[1] } else { '<absent>' }
    $badEmail = $line -match 'pendragon\.josh@gmail\.com'
    $badPath = $line -match 'Users\\graff|\\\\?\\C:'
    $ok = -not $badEmail -and -not $badPath
    if (-not $ok) { $fail++ }
    Write-Host ("{0} L{1}: ok={2} owner=[{3}] created_by=[{4}] srp=[{5}]" -f $c.f, $n, $ok, $owner, $created, $srp)
    # JSON parse sanity
    try { $null = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Write-Host "  JSON PARSE FAIL: $_"; $fail++ }
  }
}
Write-Host "failures=$fail"
exit $fail
```
